headings.usage: Use for all page titles, card headers, and major section labels.

mono.usage: Patient IDs, Confidence Scores, Coordinates, Dates.

usage_rules.background: Use pure #09090b for the main app background to reduce glare.
usage_rules.cards: Use #18181b with a 1px border of #27272a. NO SHADOWS in dark mode, use borders.
usage_rules.accents: Use 'Electric Blue' (#3b82f6) for primary actions. Use 'Danger Red' (#ef4444) ONLY for 'Fracture Detected' states.
usage_rules.gradients: Avoid large gradients. Use subtle radial glows behind key elements (like the X-ray viewer).

layout_strategy.grid_system: The Bento Grid (Mode B - High Density)

spacing.base: Relaxed but precise. Use p-6 or p-8 for containers, but gap-4 for dense data grids.
spacing.containers: All containers with borders MUST have p-6 internal padding.

landing.description: Immersive dark hero. Center: A 3D or animated 2D bone being 'scanned'. Typography: Large, tracking-tighter.

dashboard.description: Sidebar navigation (collapsed by default on mobile). Main area: Dense grid of stats. Right panel: Recent activity.

structure: Right Panel: AI Analysis & Controls (Floating or Fixed)

custom_components.name: XrayViewer
custom_components.description: A specialized image viewer with Zoom/Pan capabilities. MUST support overlaying a semi-transparent Heatmap (Grad-CAM).

custom_components.name: ConfidenceGauge
custom_components.description: A semi-circle or linear gauge showing the probability of fracture. Color transitions from Green (Normal) to Red (Fracture).

custom_components.name: StatusBadge
custom_components.description: Pill-shaped badge with 'dot' indicator. Green dot = Normal, Red pulse dot = Fracture.

styling_overrides.radius: rounded-md (Keep it technical, not too round)

scanlines.css: background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 2px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) 3px); pointer-events: none;
scanlines.usage: Overlay on the X-ray image to give a 'monitor' feel.

tech_corners.description: SVG brackets absolute positioned at the corners of the X-ray viewer container.

glassmorphism.usage: Use only for floating toolbars on top of the X-ray image.

interactions.name: Scan Effect
interactions.description: A horizontal line moving up and down across the X-ray image during 'Processing' state.

interactions.name: Panel Slide
interactions.description: Sidebars should slide in from off-screen (AnimatePresence).

images.hero_bg: Abstract dark mesh or subtle grid.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is APCA compliant. Pure white text on #09090b is safe.
accessibility.color_blindness: Do not rely on Red/Green alone. Use Icons (Check vs Alert) and Text Labels alongside colors.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for main backgrounds.
Inputs and Buttons must have a 'data-testid' attribute.
All API calls must be mocked if backend is not ready.
Ensure the X-ray viewer handles different aspect ratios without distortion (object-contain).
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Shadcn UI with the 'slate' or 'zinc' base color.
3. Create the 'XrayViewer' component early - it's the core feature.
4. Implement the 'Scan Effect' animation for the loading state of the prediction.
5. Use the 'Radiology Dark' theme variables in tailwind.config.js.
